snippet.title: Salvus: Aries Otome OP Anime Trailer
snippet.description:
The Salvus: Aries opening anime is here! For the final version for our otome, the non anime bits will be updated to be more dynamic, but please, PLEASE perceive this absolute beauty. Thank you so much @Buta Productions for working with us, and making the most beautiful opening we could dream of. It's been a pleasure to work together, and seeing our characters come to life is really emotional. I will play this on repeat for the rest of my life.

Thank you Nem-P and Aohi Rame for the beautiful music. Mors for the character designs. And animation credits below!

Wishlist Salvus: Aries here! https://store.steampowered.com/app/2104400/Salvus_Aries/ 
Early Access coming March 27th
